critical_code_review_comments: codebase_health.py — bypass logic correctly checks is_admin OR is_unlimited OR tier=='founder' on BOTH /scan rate-limit and /fix token-deduction paths. Cleanly separates the two cohorts so a founder's auto-promotion via FOUNDER_EMAILS env doesn't accidentally unlock free users.

Dashboard.jsx — onToolClick now dispatches new CustomEvent('aurem:toggle-graph', {detail:{open:true}}) and the old navigate('/feature-window') is removed. Good separation: the GraphPanel drawer is owned by ChatPanel and the sidebar just sends an event — no tight coupling.
SidebarBound.jsx — TOOLS.filter no longer gates 'graph' to founders. Verified by unit test test_sidebar_graph_visible_to_all_users.

PreviewPanel.jsx — synthetic live_url block prepended is a clean, non-destructive approach; the useEffect ensures index 0 selection. Cosmetic suggestion (NOT a bug): consider memoising effectiveBlocks if realBlocks is large to avoid re-prepending on every render.

Test naming inconsistency: test_iter212m110_founder_bypass_and_graph.py needs to be run from /app/backend (not /app) because it does `from routers import codebase_health` — a conftest.py with sys.path injection in /app/backend/tests/ would make these robust to either working directory. Not a regression — just a quality-of-life hint for future agents.

rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — this iteration validates a clean fix. RCA of the ORIGINAL issues (for reference): (a) Codebase Graph leak — Dashboard.jsx onToolClick was calling navigate('/feature-window') which is the AUREM team's INTERNAL architecture explorer. Fix dispatches aurem:toggle-graph and lets ChatPanel's GraphPanel handle the drawer with the user's own repo graph. (b) Founder bypass — codebase_health.py /scan only checked is_admin previously; extended to is_admin OR is_unlimited OR tier=='founder' to match the existing assert_has_budget() founder semantics. /fix similarly skips deduction. (c) Preview default tab — effectiveBlocks now prepends a synthetic {lang:'live_url', label:'Live Site', code: activeProject.preview_url} so Live Site is index 0 whenever a deployed URL exists.
